title: Severe Longitudinal Roadway Crack and Joint Failure
description:
[AI Vision Assessment]: The deep, continuous longitudinal crack presents a severe destabilization hazard for two-wheeled vehicles such as motorcycles and bicycles, which can get caught in the fissure. Furthermore, there is no active safety perimeter or warning signage in place. If left untreated, water infiltration will rapidly erode the underlying sub-base, leading to structural road collapse or severe pothole formation.

[Environmental Risk]: No hazardous chemical toxicity detected visually. However, unchecked water runoff carrying automotive fluids will directly infiltrate the subterranean water table through the open fissure, risking localized groundwater contamination.
assignedDepartment: Department of Public Works - Road Maintenance Division
